And yesterday i research a lot about what i should choose as a microcontroller or a devboard or something and at last i struck at the our classic ESP32 well it's NOT FINIAL STILL but it's a 90% chances i will stick to the yestyerday's components okay so um um okay i am offical beginning

---

yo so basically starting project tone dial for music week and half life week 3!! its a skypiea tone dial inspired by brook from one piece (soul king yohoho). its not just a dumb macropad or cheap speaker, its a full standalone voice synth + usb midi controller + digital pet thingy that lives on my desk.

btw here are the main componets im using and why:

* esp32-s3-zero: using this mcu becuase dual core 240mhz is cracked, core 0 can do wifi + groq whisper/llama api and core 1 does real time i2s audio and midi without any jitter. plus native usb so pc detects it as real midi instrment!!
* max98357a i2s amp + 40mm 3w speker + pasive radiator: droped the dumb 12v boost idea bcuz it drains battery and makes rf noise on wifi. this amp runs direct on 3.7v lipo and the ruber passive radiator gives actual punchy bass in a sealed cad chamber
* inmp441 mems mic: digital i2s mic so no analog buzzing or static when talking to groq ai
* vl53l0x laser tof sensor: optical theremin lol!! shoots an actual laser so i can wave my hand in the air to bend synth pitch and filter cutoff like a theremin/d-beam
* 1.28 inch round touch screen: looks like a real spiral shell dial instead of an ugly square box, shows brooks animated face and soul meter
* 4x kailh mech switches + ec11 dial: plays chords and acts as cpr defibulator buttons when brook gets a random heart attack if his soul meter hits 0% lmao
* tp4056 + 1500mah lipo: makes it fully portble so i can jam anywhere for 4-5 hrs

total budget is under $65 and im keeping ~320 inr reserved for print legion volunteer filament + private dtdc/delhivery courier bcuz india post will def smash the 3d print into peices lol. time to wire the kicad schematic lets goooo
